audio_text_deviations.canonical_text_before_local_rewrite: Then he remembered the hands held out for the chains. His friend had trusted him without asking for another promise. Water dripped from a crack in the rock. Melos drank, pushed himself onto his knees, and stood. One step. Another. At the city gates, the execution bell rang. He ran toward the square. Above his friend, the sword was already raised.
